# Fix-It Saturday at St. Ansgar

**Saturday, December 5, 2026 · 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. · Fellowship Hall, St. Ansgar Lutheran Church, Minneapolis**

Something's broken, and it probably doesn't need to go in the trash. It likely just needs a screw, a new cord, or somebody who knows what to do with it.

**It's free.** No membership required, no sign-up. Donations to the food shelf are welcome but not expected.

Please bring **one item per person** to start, so the line keeps moving. Then stay for coffee and kringle. Both are provided.

**The fixers so far:**
- Small appliances
- Lamps
- Bikes
- Clothing mending
- Knife sharpening
- Laptops and phones — one retired tech guy, and he's very good

At the mending table: **Doris Lindqvist**, who is 84 and has been darning socks for this parish since the Carter years, has asked to run it herself. She's the boss of that table, and rightly so.

The whole idea was born in the church kitchen, when **Marv Okafor** fixed my 1970s Hamilton Beach mixer in twenty minutes while I stood there holding it. Too much gets thrown away that just needs a screw or a new cord. Somebody should fix it instead.

**We need more volunteer fixers** — especially anyone who can do vacuums or zippers. If you can fix things and want to help, please come. Coffee's free for fixers too.

After December 5, we'll keep it up the **first Saturday of every month through spring** — January 2, February 6, March 6, and on after that.

This is good neighboring, plain and simple. No strings, and nobody will preach at you. Bring the broken toaster, and stay for coffee.

**Questions, or to sign up to help:** the church office, 612-555-0148 or office@stansgarlutheran.example.

---

One note: I used only the location details you gave — if you want the street address and parking info on the printed version for the coffee shops and library, add that line and I can fold it into the top. Want me to tighten this to a half-page for the flyers, too?
